call_points.text: ARPOB growth guided at 9-10% YoY for FY27.
Gurugram 250-bed hospital expected to go live in Q1 of next fiscal.
Adjusted EBITDA margin excluding New Delhi and Faridabad Sector 20 was 28.1%.
Debt rose to about ₹300 Cr from ₹210 Cr in March, including ₹80 Cr for the Gurgaon acquisition.
Depreciation guided at ~₹29 Cr per quarter for the next three quarters.
Interest cost rose to ₹6.6 Cr from ₹5 Cr last quarter; management expects it to continue at this level.
Government payer mix at ~40% for the group, but newer hospitals keep it below 10%.
Board approved maiden interim dividend of 5% of face value and first ESOP grant under ESOP scheme 2026.
EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 24-25% for FY27 despite new hospital drag.
Brownfield expansion at Greater Noida and Noida Extension at ₹75 lakh capex per bed.
Oncology drug price caps impact 20-30% of pricing within the 10% oncology revenue share.
International patient inflow dipped due to West Asia crisis; management expects recovery next quarter.
Income tax issue near resolution, expected before end of Q2 FY27; no major liability expected.

operating_notes.text: Acquiring 1.30 acres of land and an under-construction building at Sector 40, Gurugram for ₹100 Cr cash, with ~250 potential beds and ₹100 Cr additional capex including medical equipment.
Acquiring an under-construction 250-bed hospital in Sector 40, Gurugram for ~₹100 Cr, with ~₹100 Cr more planned for completion and medical equipment; network over 2,500 beds with ~3,250 announced.

QIP net proceeds of ₹603.90 Cr were fully utilised by 31 March 2026: ₹95.68 Cr debt repayment, ₹217.39 Cr hospital acquisitions, ₹151.74 Cr medical equipment and ₹139.10 Cr general corporate purposes.
Model town, New Delhi hospital commenced commercial operations on July 14, 2025 with 300 beds.
Q4FY26 operating revenue reached a record high of ₹341.60 Cr, up 47% YoY, driven by strong traction across newer hospitals.
Q4FY26 occupancy 71%, FY26 68%; ARPOB ₹33,282 in Q4, up 5% YoY.
Agra hospital monthly revenue run rate ~₹7 Cr with 18% EBITDA margin.
Government payer mix ~35%, target ~25% in two years.
Group ARPOB reached an all-time high of ₹34,758 in Q1FY27, up 7% YoY.
Census beds increased to 1,820 from 1,655 in the previous quarter.
Doctor attrition at ~7% overall, below 3-4% for senior doctors.

timeline.summary: On 13 May 2026, Yatharth's board approved buying a hospital asset at Sector 40, Gurugram from RNY Healthcare Services for ₹100 Cr cash, with ~250 potential beds and a further ₹100 Cr of planned capex.
On 13 May 2026, Yatharth's board approved buying an under-construction 250-bed hospital in Sector 40, Gurugram for ~₹100 Cr, with ~₹100 Cr more planned for completion and equipment.
On May 14, 2026, Yatharth Hospital reported that shareholders approved the creation of security under Section 180(1)(a) via postal ballot with 99.99% assent.
On May 14, 2026, Yatharth Hospital submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 showing ₹48.45 Cr unutilized IPO proceeds.
On 14 May 2026, Yatharth's final Crisil monitoring report showed the entire ₹603.90 Cr net QIP proceeds utilised by 31 March 2026, with a ₹0.05 Cr mis-utilisation rectified in the quarter.
Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd. schedules Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 26, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST post-results, led by Mr. Yatharth Tyagi, Whole-time Director.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹341.56 Cr; net profit ₹44.7 Cr (+15.4% YoY).
On May 25, 2026, Yatharth Hospital reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹341.60 Cr and net profit of ₹44.70 Cr.
RITESH MISHRA, Director, announces Yatharth Hospital’s 16th Annual Investor Conference on May 29, 2026, at Mumbai via Investor 360 One.
Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Limited hosted Q4FY26 earnings call on May 26, 2026, at 11:00 AM (IST) with recording available on its website.
Yatharth Hospital's Q4 FY26 earnings call (May 26, 2026) guided FY27 revenue growth above FY26's 36% and EBITDA margin above 24%, with 5,000-bed target over three years.
Yatharth Hospital Q1FY27 earnings call: revenue ₹393 Cr (+51% YoY), EBITDA ₹92 Cr (23.3% margin), PAT ₹45 Cr; guided FY27 EBITDA margin at 24%+ and 5,000 beds in ~2.5 years.
All resolutions of the 1st/2026-27 EGM held on 15 Oct 2026 were approved with requisite majority.
